The FP64 projector + FP64 CholeskyQR + FP64 1-NS recipe is minimal; profile confirms ~48% d884gemm (FP64 tensor, cutlass_80 Ampere-gen NOT sm_100-native) + ~16% FP64 trsm/potrf.

THREAD 1b/2 (peel mixed sub-populations) = MEASURED NEGATIVE on THIS parent, reproducing brief-10/7 with NEW per-class data. Fresh structure probe found the sub-populations DO exist: mixed512 (b640) = 264 dense(PR~55) + 76 psd + 50 band(bw<=16, offband16=0) + 50 repeated + 45 nearrank + 46 rowscale + 40 spectrum + 37 clustered(2-level, A2v-v~1e-5) + 32 rankdef(erank~384). But end-to-end best-partition peel (clustered->2-level + concentrated->low-rank + rest->cuSOLVER) MEASURED: mixed512 174.1ms vs 163.6 whole (LOSS +6.4%); mixed1024 220ms vs 105 whole (LOSS +109%, tiny b=60 underfills worst). ROOT CAUSE quantified fresh: cuSOLVER's WHOLE-BATCH rate is 255us/mat, but every GATHERED subset costs 298-896us/mat (GPU underfill) + a ~25ms fixed per-call floor (sum of 9 per-class calls = 314ms vs 163ms whole). So peeling saves only ~255us/mat from the whole call while the fast path pays underfill+floor -- class-independent, fundamental. Even band (disproportionately 629us/mat when gathered) loses: in the whole batch it's only ~255us marginal.
